card.statement:
The functor $\mathsf{R}^{G}_{L}$
sends the convolution product on $\mathrm{P}_{{G_{\mathcal{O}}}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{k})$ to the convolution product on $\mathrm{P}_{L_{\mathcal{O}}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{L},\mathbf{k})$ , in a way compatible with associativity and commutativity constraints.
card.label: Proposition 15.2

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
